description: This Java class, ModelGroupReader, is responsible for reading and managing entity group definitions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It loads XML resources, parses entity-group elements, manages caches of entity-to-group mappings, and provides methods for retrieving group information by entity name or delegator.

classes.name: ModelGroupReader
classes.description: A class for reading and caching entity group definitions, parsing XML resource files, and providing access to entity-group relationships within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelGroupReader
methods.description: Factory method to retrieve a singleton instance of ModelGroupReader for a given delegator name.

methods.name: getGroupCache
methods.description: Loads and caches the mapping of entity names to group names from XML resource files for a specific delegator.

methods.name: getEntityGroupName
methods.description: Retrieves the group name associated with a given entity within a specific delegator context.

methods.name: getGroupNames
methods.description: Returns all group names defined for a specified delegator, including the default group.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Returns a set of entity names that belong to a specified group within a given delegator context.
